Rooms.Name: The Trail In the Plains
Rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading east. The wide landscape stretches far
away in every direction. To the north you see big Mountains and to
the south you see King Welmar's Castle.

Exits.Description: The plains continue to the west.

Rooms.Name: The Plains
Rooms.Description:
The wide plain stretches out in front of you, miles upon miles
with nothing more than bushes and solitary flowers growing. It is
almost like there is no apparent end of it.

Rooms.Name: The Plains
Rooms.Description:
The wide plain stretches out in front of you, miles upon miles
with nothing more than bushes and solitary flowers growing. It is
almost like there is no apparent end of it.

Rooms.Name: The Plains
Rooms.Description:
The wide plain stretches out in front of you, miles upon miles
with nothing more than bushes and solitary flowers growing. It is
almost like there is no apparent end of it.

Rooms.Name: The Plains
Rooms.Description:
The wide plain stretches out in front of you, miles upon miles
with nothing more than bushes and solitary flowers growing. It is
almost like there is no apparent end of it.

Rooms.Name: The Trail In the Plains
Rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading east. The wide grassland stretches far
away in every direction. To the north you see big Mountains and to
the south you see King Welmar's Castle.

Rooms.Name: The Trail In the Plains
Rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading east. The wide grassland stretches far
away in every direction. To the north you see big Mountains and to
the south you see King Welmar's Castle. Further east you see a bridge
over a river.

Rooms.Name: An Old Bridge
Rooms.Description:
You are on a very old bridge. To the east you see a large forest,
to the north you see big mountains and to the south you see King
Welmar's Castle.  You can climb down on to the river on the side of
the bridge.

Rooms.Name: The Trail In the Plains
Rooms.Description:
The trail makes a turn to the north following the river. To the
north you see big Mountains. And to the east you see a large forest.

Rooms.Name: A Trail Along The River
Rooms.Description:
You follow a trail leading northwards along the river. To the
south you can see a bridge over the river. To the north you see big
Mountains and to the east you see a large forest.

Rooms.Name: A Trail Along The River
Rooms.Description:
The trail forks into two branches, one to the north and the other
to the east. A large stone is standing here. To the north you see big
Mountains and to the east you see a large forest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The stone got something written on it.
To the north lies the Dwarven Village.
To the south lies the City of Midgaard.
To the east lies the Elven Forest of Namir, Gnome Village.

Rooms.Name: A Trail Along the River
Rooms.Description:
You follow a trail north. The moria mountains don't seem to be
that far away anymore. To the east lies the forest of Namir and to
the west you hear the rippling sound of a river.

Rooms.Name: End of trail Along the River
Rooms.Description:
You follow a trail north. The Moria mountains don't seem to be
that far away anymore. To the east lies the forest of Namir and to
the west the rippling sound of a river subsides as the trail takes
you away from the river.

Rooms.Name: The Edge of the Forest
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a trail, near the eastern edge of the large
forest of Namir. To the west you see the trail leading back to the
walled city of Midgaard, and to the east a trail is leading through
the forest.

Rooms.Name: A trail through the forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a trail winding through the forest. To the west lies
the forest edge and to the east the trail continues deeper into the
forest. As you look closer to the north you see a small path leading
into the forest. And to the south you can leave the trail and go
straight into the forest.

Rooms.Name: In the Forest
Rooms.Description:
As you leave the trail you sense the tranquillity of the forest
surround you.  Birds singing and animals can be heard making strange
noises in the distance.  To the north you see a trail winding west
and east through the forest and to the south you can continue deeper
into the forest.

Rooms.Name: At the Hills
Rooms.Description:
As you wander deeper into the forest you see some hills to the
east.  When you get closer you discover a dark cave in one of them.
To the north you can tread back into the forest and if you go to the
west you move closer to the dark cave.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to the Dark Cave
Rooms.Description:
You stand in front of a dark cave. A large sign have been struck
deep into the ground here. To the east you can move away from the
hills and to the west you can enter the dark cave.

Rooms.Name: A small path in the forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading through the forest. Large trees
loom everywhere. To the south the trail continues through the forest
and to the north the narrow path continues between the large trees.

Rooms.Name: A turn in the small path
Rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading south and east, trees standing
close on all sides. As the forest is getting more dense the light
that comes from above is dimming. To the south the path makes its way
southward and to the east the path continues into the forest.

Rooms.Name: A small path in the forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading east and west through the forest.
Large trees looms close on every side. Its getting darker as the
large trees almost block all light from above. The path continues to
the east and to the west.

Exits.Description: Here you can leave the path and go straight into the forest.

Rooms.Name: In the forest
Rooms.Description:
As you leave the trail you sense the tranquillity of the forest
surround you.  Birds sing and animals are making strange noises in
the distance. To the south you see a trail winding west and east
through the forest.

Exits.Description: As you look closer to the north you see a small path in the distance.

Rooms.Name: A trail through the forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading west and east through the forest. To
the east, the forest gradually becomes more dense.

Exits.Description: This way you can leave the trail and go straight into the forest.

Rooms.Name: A narrow path in the forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a narrow path leading through the forest. Large trees
loom everywhere. To the north the trail continues through the forest
and to the south the narrow path continues into the dark forest.

Rooms.Name: A turn in the narrow path
Rooms.Description:
You are on a narrow path leading north and east, trees standing
close on all sides. As the forest is getting more dense the light
form above can't penetrate the canopies of the trees. To the north
the path makes its way northward and to the east the path continues
into the dark forest.

Rooms.Name: A small path in the dark forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading east and west through the dark
forest. Large trees looms close on every side. The path continues to
the east and the west.

Rooms.Name: A small path in the dark forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading east and west through the dark
forest. Large trees looms close on every side. The path continues to
the east and the west.

Rooms.Name: A small path in the dark forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading east and west through the dark
forest. Large trees loom close on every side. The path branches 
here, getting lighter to the east, but with a narrower trail 
leading north between the trees.

Rooms.Name: A trail through the dense forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading north and south between huge, ancient
trees standing close on all side. To the west a small path leads into
the shadows.

Rooms.Name: A trail through the dense forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading west and east through the forest. The
forest is becoming more dense, huge trees loom on all sides.

Rooms.Name: A trail through the dense forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading west and east through the forest. Here
a well traveled trail from the south join up. A road sign is standing
here pointing south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
To the south lies the splendid Elven City of ILLIR.
If your intentions are evil continue on 
your own risk. To the east lies the gnome
village.

Rooms.Name: A trail through the dense forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading west and east through the forest. The
forest is becoming more dense, huge trees loom on all sides.

Rooms.Name: A trail through the dense forest
Rooms.Description:
Here the east and west roaming trail makes a turn to the north. 
From the east a small path joins with this trail.

Rooms.Name: A trail through the dense forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading north and south through the forest. The
forest is getting very dense, huge ancient trees looms over you form
all sides.

Rooms.Name: A trail through the dense forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading north and south through the forest. The
forest is getting very dense, huge ancient trees looms over you form
all sides.

Rooms.Name: A trail through the dense forest
Rooms.Description:
Here the north and south leading trail makes a turn to the east.
The forest is very dense. Blocking almost all light. As you look east
you see that the forest is getting less dense.

Rooms.Name: A trail through the forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading east and west through the forest. The
forest is getting less dense to the east.

Rooms.Name: At the edge of the forest
Rooms.Description:
You are at the edge of the forest. To the north a dusty path
continues toward the plains. And to the west you can enter the forest
of Namir.

Rooms.Name: Narrow path in the dark forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a narrow path leading east and west through the dark
forest.  Large trees looms close on every side. The path continues to
the east and the west. To the east you can see some light in the
distance.

Rooms.Name: On a well traveled trail
Rooms.Description:
You are on a well traveled trail leading north and both east and
west. Trees stand close on all sides. A strange feeling comes over you.
You feel like something or someone is watching you. Both to the west 
and north, the path leads into the dark forest. To the east the path 
makes its way through the trees next to the river. South there was 
once a wooden bridge forged across a small river, but it is now long
gone.

Rooms.Name: On a well traveled trail
Rooms.Description:
You are on a well traveled trail leading north and south. Trees
stand close on both sides. A strange feeling comes over you, you feel
like something or someone is watching you.

Rooms.Name: A path through the trees
Rooms.Description:
You are on a path leading west and east through the trees. This
place doesn't seem to like your intrusion. As you start to move
further east.  "SWISH!" Before you got time to react an arrow passes
by your head one inch from your right ear. Maybe its time to run.

Rooms.Name: Elven guard camp
Rooms.Description:
As you enter this place you see a campfire burning. You can see
elves sitting around the fire relaxing. "SWWWIIISSH!" Now the elves
seems to be alert. They all readied their bows and aiming at you. You
better get out of here.

Rooms.Name: A path through the trees
Rooms.Description:
You are on a path leading west and east through the trees. This
place doesn't seem to like your intrusion. As you start to move
further west. "SWISH!" Before you got time to react an arrow passes
by your head one inch from your right ear. Maybe its time to run.

Rooms.Name: A small path through the dense forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading west and east through the forest.
The forest becomes a little less dense here. Further east you can
make out the beginning of a marsh. When you continue walking
eastwards you notice that an old overgrown road leads north into the
forest, you can barely see it as high grass and bushes covers almost
all of it.

Rooms.Name: A small path through the forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading west and east through the forest.
Further east lies a large marsh.

Rooms.Name: The marsh
Rooms.Description:
The whole forest has been transformed. The old green trees have
been replaced by dark branches emerging from the marsh. The sound of
birds have been turned into the sound of croaking frogs.

Exits.Description: The marsh continues to the east.

Rooms.Name: The marsh
Rooms.Description:
You stand in the start of the large marsh. The marsh stretches out
as far as you can see to the north and east. To the south you can go
back into the forest.

Rooms.Name: The marsh
Rooms.Description:
You stand in the start of the large marsh. The marsh stretches out
as far as you can see to the south and east. To the north you can go
back into the forest.

Rooms.Name: A path through the trees
Rooms.Description:
You are on a path leading west and east through the trees. From
the south you can hear the faint sound of water.

Rooms.Name: A turn in the path through the trees
Rooms.Description:
You are on a path leading west and east through the trees. Here
the path turns south. From the south you can hear the sound of water.

Rooms.Name: At the north river bank
Rooms.Description:
You are on the north side of a river. A path follows the river
east, and to the north a path leads into the forest. On the south
side of the river you can see a path disappearing into the forest.
Maybe its possible to cross the river.

Exits.Description: As you look closer you can see flat stones under the water.

Rooms.Name: Along the north side of the river
Rooms.Description:
You are on a path leading west and east along a river. To the west
the path goes into the forest and to the east the path continue along
side the river.

Rooms.Name: Along the north side of the river
Rooms.Description: You are on a path leading west and east along a river.

Rooms.Name: Along the north side of the river
Rooms.Description: You are on a path leading west and east along a river.

Rooms.Name: The Strange Mist
Rooms.Description:
Suddenly a strange mist covers the whole area, you cant see more
then ten feet in any direction. The only thing that give you some
kind of direction is the sound of the river to the south.

Rooms.Name: Wading over the river
Rooms.Description: You try to wade over the river, making your way slowly but safe.

Rooms.Name: At the south river bank
Rooms.Description:
You are on the south side of a river. A path follows the river
west, and to the south a path makes its way into the forest. On the
north side of the river you can see a path going north and east.
Maybe its possible to cross the river.  A strange feeling comes over
you, you felt like something or someone is watching you.

Exits.Description: As you look closer you can see flat stones under the water.

Rooms.Name: A path in the forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a south and north leading path in a forest. The forest
is getting darker as you move further south.

Rooms.Name: A dark path in the forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a path leading south and north in a forest. As the
forest is getting more dense, almost no light can make its way
through the trees.

Rooms.Name: A dark path in the dense forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a dark path leading south and north in a dense forest.
Almost no light can make its way through the trees.

Rooms.Name: A dark path in the dense forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a dark path leading south and north in a dense forest.
Almost no light can make its way through the trees.

Rooms.Name: A dark path in the dense forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a dark path leading south and north in a dense forest.
Almost no light can make its way through the trees.

Rooms.Name: A dark path in the dense forest
Rooms.Description:
You are on a dark path leading south and north in a dense forest.
Almost no light can make its way through the trees.

Rooms.Name: Following the river
Rooms.Description:
You are on a west and east leading path along a river.  To the
west you can hear some sounds of activity.  A strange feeling comes
over you, you feel like something or someone is watching over you.

Rooms.Name: Near the elven city of Illir
Rooms.Description:
You stand in a huge clearing in the forest. Around you are lots of
small farms and large fields and pastures. To the northwest you see a
bright shiny stonewall surrounding a city. High towers can be seen
behind the wall. The path continue through the fields to the west and
to the east you can follow a path along the river.

Rooms.Name: Near the elven city of Illir
Rooms.Description:
You stand in a huge clearing in the forest. Around you are lots of
small farms and large fields and pastures. To the north you see a
bright shiny stone wall surrounding a city. High towers can be seen
behind the wall. The path continues through the fields to the east 
and to the south.

Rooms.Name: Near the elven city of Illir
Rooms.Description:
You stand in a huge clearing in the forest. Around you are lots of
small farms and large fields and pastures. To the north you see a
bright shiny stonewall surrounding a city. High towers can be seen
behind the wall. The path continue through the fields to the west and
to the north.

Rooms.Name: Near the elven city of Illir
Rooms.Description:
You stand in a huge clearing in the forest. Around you are lots of
small farms and large fields and pastures. To the northwest you see a
bright shiny stonewall surrounding a city. High towers can be seen
behind the wall. The path continue through the fields to the west and
to the east.

Rooms.Name: Near the elven city of Illir
Rooms.Description:
You stand in a huge clearing in the forest. Around you are lots of
small farms and large fields and pastures. To the northwest you see a
bright shiny stonewall surrounding a city. High towers can be seen
behind the wall. The path continue through the fields to the north
and to the east.

Rooms.Name: Near the elven city of Illir
Rooms.Description:
You stand in a huge clearing in the forest. Around you are lots of
small farms and large fields and pastures. To the northwest you see a
bright shiny stonewall surrounding a city. High towers can be seen
behind the wall. The path continue through the fields north and to
the south.

Rooms.Name: Near the elven city of Illir
Rooms.Description:
You are on a well traveled trail leading north and south. Around
you are lots of small farms and large fields and pastures. To the
east you see a bright shiny white stonewall surrounding a city. High
towers can be seen behind the wall. The well traveled trail continue
through the fields north and to the east. A path makes its way
through the fields south.

Rooms.Name: Narrow trail through the forest
Rooms.Description:
The trail begins to rise sharply as you reach the foothills at the 
east end of the Moria mountain range. The trees are growing very close 
together here, and the trail winds it's way between them.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's not very wide and seems to have been made by animals rather than 
humans. There are some footprints here.

There's a mixture of different kinds. Wolves, boars, and big cats 
have all passed along this trail recently.

Rooms.Name: Steep trail through the forest
Rooms.Description:
The forest covers the side of the mountain range to the north, and 
becomes so steep that it is impossible to climb further. Looking south 
you can see the rest of the forest stretching out into the distance, and 
to the north the dark mountains tower above you. The trail leads east 
from here along the mountainside, or south into the forest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's not very wide and seems to have been made by animals rather than 
humans. There are some footprints here.

There's a mixture of different kinds. Wolves, boars, and big cats 
have all passed along this trail recently.

Rooms.Name: Trail through the forest
Rooms.Description:
The trail continues through the thick forest, twisting and turning 
to avoid the huge trees. The moutainside is too steep here to climb 
either up or down, the trail leads west and east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's not very wide and seems to have been made by animals rather than 
humans. There are some footprints here.

There's a mixture of different kinds. Wolves, boars, and big cats 
have all passed along this trail recently.

Mobs.Name: elf archer
Mobs.LongDescription: A Elven archer is hiding in the trees.
Mobs.Description:
The elven archer is wearing green clothes making him disappear in
the vegetation. He points a bow with a nocked arrow at you.

Mobs.Name: cow
Mobs.LongDescription: A cow is standing here eating.
Mobs.Description: The cow looks very well feed.

Mobs.Name: horse
Mobs.Description: The horse look very well feed.

Mobs.Name: deer
Mobs.LongDescription: A deer is here eating from some bushes.
Mobs.ActionScript: %10 emote looks up and eyes you with suspicion.

Mobs.Name: rabbit
Mobs.LongDescription: A rabbit is jumping around here.

Mobs.Name: badger
Mobs.LongDescription: A badger is digging a hole here.

Mobs.Name: snake
Mobs.LongDescription: A green snake is slithering over the path here.

Mobs.Name: black bear
Mobs.LongDescription: A Black bear is resting here better leave it alone.
Mobs.Description: The bear looks huge and very dangerous.

Mobs.Name: huge spider
Mobs.LongDescription: A huge spider drops down from above.

Mobs.Name: highwayman man
Mobs.LongDescription: A Highway man charges you from nowhere.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This bow have been made by the best elf craftsmen available.

Objects.Name: elven chain chainmail
Objects.Description: A shiny chainmail is lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This chainmail has been made by the best elf craftsmen available.

Objects.Name: fur bear black
Objects.Description: A black fur from a bear lies here.

Objects.Name: elven boots leather
Objects.Description: A pair of well crafted boots have been carelessly left here.
